art_note: Flat-lay product shots are clean, but the on-model composites look artificial and diminish luxury appeal.
desc_en: Wrap yourself in exceptional comfort with this hooded cape crafted from soft fleece fabric. The fluid silhouette features a practical button closure and two front pockets, allowing total freedom of movement. A versatile garment conceived for indoor lounging or outdoor settings. Each piece is made to order and available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Envuélvete en una comodidad excepcional con esta capa con capucha confeccionada en suave tejido de fleece. Su silueta fluida presenta un diseño práctico con cierre de botones y dos bolsillos delanteros, permitiendo total libertad de movimiento. Una prenda versátil concebida para el descanso en interiores o para la intemperie. Cada pieza se elabora bajo pedido y cuenta con envío mundial.
